channel.title: SubTrack Pro Guides
channel.description: Practical guides for keeping track of subscriptions and free trials, from the makers of SubTrack Pro.

item.title: Free trial reminder: how to never get charged after a free trial
item.description: Five ways to stop a free trial from turning into a charge: calendar alerts, virtual cards, cancelling early and trackers, compared.

item.title: How to track all your subscriptions in one place
item.description: Find every subscription in your card statements, app stores, email and password manager, then keep them in one simple list you can trust.

item.title: How to find hidden subscriptions: a 15-minute audit checklist
item.description: A 15-minute checklist to uncover forgotten subscriptions in card statements, Apple and Google Play settings, email receipts and a CSV export.

item.title: Annual vs monthly plans: when is the yearly plan actually cheaper?
item.description: Use a simple break-even formula to see when an annual plan beats monthly billing, plus refund, cancellation and renewal-reminder caveats.
